newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $660 mln for Oct 24.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $660 mln for Oct 24.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $660 million in 32 offerings for Thursday October 24, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $174 million in 21 offerings. The largest issue is a $30 million Monmouth County, N.J., issue at 1100 EDT.
Negotiated sales total $485 million in 11 offerings. The largest issue is a $178 million Chicago O'Hare Airport revenue bond issue through Bear Stearns & Co.

An additional two negotiated deals totaling $42 million are on Reuter's day-to-day calendar, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues on Wednesday depending on market conditions. --U.S. Municipal Information Group, 212-859-1826
